If you're looking for someone in particular, I may be able to help.", "In case you hadn't noticed, I'm a Dunmer. I am a Temple member. I've nothing in particular against the Imperial cult. But I've no particular feelings of generosity towards them, either.", "Yes. I see. Perhaps you are right. There's no cheaper way to gather goodwill than to buy a little of it. And the goodwill of the Imperial cult may be worth something in this town, as you say. Very well. Here's a bottle of Cyrodilic brandy for your cult's fund-raising dinner, with my compliments and best wishes.", 'Health to you and your cult.']

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ['Yes, outlander. I am Dutadalk, gulakhan of the Ahemmusa Ashlanders. Why are you here? What do you want?', 'You are Indoril. We have heard some say you are the Nerevarine. For a long time the Ashlanders have heard of the Nerevarine prophecies. Perhaps some would say the Ahemmusa are bitter. But talk gives us no comfort.', 'We are the Ahemmusa tribe. Ahemmusa camp was the last safe place of the Ahemmusa, but it is safe no longer. The blight has taken our lands, our herds, our game, our people. The red clouds spoil our herds and kill the game. The blight-sickness kills our herds and cripples our people. These are the last days of the Ahemmusa.', 'Speak to the wise woman, Sinnammu Mirpal. Tell her you will find a safe place for the Ahemmusa. That is what I would wish to hear from one who wants to be named Nerevarine.', 'You must forgive us. Perhaps these are great days. Perhaps the prophecies are fulfilled. But to the Ahemmusa, all we know is that hunger and disease stalks us, and monsters prey upon us. A hero reborn may be a wonderful thing. But it means little to us, unless we have a safe place.', 'If you are the Nerevarine, then you will find a safe place for the Ahemmusa.', 'Thank you, Indoril. You have made a safe place for the Ahemmusa. You have my thanks, and my support.', "Mamaea is our healer. You'll find her in her tent.", "Our trader, Lanabi, has her yurt with the ashkhan's and the gulakhan's yurts."]

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ["I'm looking for a friend of mine, a female Khajiit named Addhiranirr. Do you know where I can find her?", 'Sorry to bother you.', 'I see. Well, perhaps some other good citizen can tell me where to find her.', "Yes. As I said, I'm looking for a friend of mine, a female Khajiit named Addhiranirr. I thought you might be able to tell me where to find her.", 'Yes. Her name is Addhiranirr, and she is a Khajiit. Do you know where I can find her?', "What a disappointment. But thank you for your time. I was just heading back to the mainland myself, anyway, and maybe I'll run into her there.", 'I see. Well, perhaps some other good citizen can tell me where to find her.', "Oh. I see. How curious. *Sigh.* Well. I suppose I need to go change my clothes if I'm going down there. But thank you for your time and courtesy. And don't tell her about me. I want it to be a surprise. Good day, and thanks again.", "It's no problem, really. Maybe I'll run into her back on the mainland.", "No, I understand. She didn't know I was coming. But it's no problem. I was just heading back to the mainland myself, and maybe I'll run into her there.", "Remember. Don't tell her you talked to me."]

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ["No, , I don't believe we've met. My name is Edryno Arethi. I don't have any official title, but I handle House Hlaalu's business here in Vivec.", 'Yes, of course, I need a courier to deliver this sealed report.', 'Take this sealed report to Baren Alen, the clerk of the Hlaalu Treasury in Vivec.', 'Like I said, deliver the sealed report to Baren Alen at the Hlaalu Treasury.', "It's not far from here. Just leave my house and go north. The Treasury connects to the vaults, the prison, and the records office.", 'Did you deliver the sealed report as I asked?', "I'm glad you were able to get that report to Baren Alen in time. Here, take these 50 drakes for your trouble.", 'You already delivered the sealed report, .', 'Did you deliver the sealed report as I asked?', "I'm glad you delivered the report, but you should not have opened it. That kind of unreliability is why I must send all my messages in code.", 'You already delivered the sealed report, .', 'What can I do for you today, ?', 'I need someone to collect a debt from Murudius Flaeus.', 'Murudius Flaeus owes a House Hlaalu noble over 800 drakes in gambling debts. He lives in Hla Oad. Go there and get the drakes from him. If he refuses to give you the money, you can kill him, but if you get the money, you can keep half of it.', 'Do you have the 800 drakes that Murudius Flaeus oews one of our nobles?', 'Then do not waste my time. Go to Hla Oad and get Murudius Flaeus to pay the money.', "Did you get Murudius Flaeus' debt money?", 'Do you have the 800 drakes that Murudius Flaeus oews one of our nobles?', "Yes, it's all here. I hope Murudius Flaeus wasn't too much trouble. You get to keep half of it, like we agreed.", 'What can I do for you today, ?', 'Bandits are always bad for business. Because of bandits on the road to Pelagiad, the Hlaalu trader Tarvyn Faren needs an escort.', 'Meet Tarvyn Faren on the road to Pelagiad, near the Silt Strider just north of the bridge to the Foreign Quarter. Escort him safely to Pelagiad.', 'Back already? I hope Tarvyn Faren made it safely to Pelagiad.', "I'm glad Tarvyn Faren arrived safely. Take these 500 drakes for helping House Hlaalu's business.", 'What can I do for you today, ?', 'Not business today, but duty. House Hlaalu sent a team to an illegal Telvanni base, but they have not returned from Odirniran.', "Go to Odirniran, on Azura's coast, west of the shrine to Azura and south of the old Dwemer ruins of Nchurdamz. I will mark these ruins on your map. If there are any survivors, ask them what needs to be done. If there are no survivors, take recenge on the foul Telvanni there.", 'Did you find out what was going on at Odirniran?', 'You killed the Telvanni and rescued Vedelea Othril? This was a great service to House Hlaalu. Please take these 1000 drakes for a job well done.', 'What can I do for you today, ?', "Today's business involves Yngling Half-Troll's prized game rats.", "Yngling Half-Troll raises game rats in Yngling Manor here in Vivec. One of his rivals snuck three blighted rats into his breeding pen. Go to Yngling Manor and kill the blighted rats, but spare his prized game rats. The game rats are used to being handled and should ignore you. The blighted rats are wild and should attack you. Here's a key to Yngling's basement.", "I just gave you a key. Go to Yngling Half_Troll's basement and kill the blighted rats. Try and leave the healthy rats alone.", "It's in the Plaza of the St. Olms Canton, near the statue. St. Olms is southeast of here, just south of the Arena.", 'So, what did you do about the game rats?', 'Yngling just told me you killed the blighted rats. Since it looks like you spread most of the game rats, Yngling told me to pay you 1000 drakes.', 'What can I do for you today, ?', 'The business of Vvardenfell is the ebony trade.', 'The Zainab have been trying to sell ebony. Go speak with the Zainab camp and make sure they only sell ebony through us.', 'The Zainab camp, is southwest of Vos in the Grazelands region. I will mark it on your map since it is easy to get lost in the Grazelands.', 'I hope you have some good news about the ebony trade.', "Thanks to you, the Empire must still buy all its ebony from House Hlaalu. Take these 1000 drakes as a share of House Hlaalu's future profits.", 'What can I do for you today, ?', "A ship wrecked off Azura's coast over a year ago. I need someone to find the wreckage of the Prelude.", 'The ship was trying to land at a secret dock and is likely to be hard to find. I believe they crashed on an island east of Bal Fell. Start there, head due east, and look around the islands you pass. It should be within two or three islands of Bal Fell. The ship was carrying a Daedric Wakizashi when it sank. Bring that Wakizashi to me. You can keep anything else you find there.', 'Have you found the Wakizashi?', 'You found the Wakizashi? What did you do with it? Bring it here.', 'You can keep everything else, but that Wakizashi is mine.', 'Did you find the Prelude? Do you have my Wakizashi?', 'Have you found the Wakizashi?', 'Yes, this is the one. Here, take these 500 drakes as a finders fee.', 'What can I do for you today, ?', "Thieves have broken into a shop here in Vivec three nights in a row. I need someone to defend Ralen Tilvur's shop.", 'As I said, thieves have broken into his shop three nights in a row. I suspect they will try again tonight. His shop is in the Plaza of the Foreign Quarter here in Vivec. Go there and kill any thieves that arrive.', "Did you catch the thief that's been bothering Ralen Tilvur?", 'Thank you for protecting Ralen Tilvur. Take these 1000 drakes as a reward from House Hlaalu.', "It's business as usual in Vivec. Speak with Crassius Curio at his manor here in the Hlaalu Compound or speak with Nileno Dorvayn in Balmora."]

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ['Are you looking for me? You want to join the Mages Guild?', 'You can get there by going around the mountains near Suran and heading northeast along the Foyada Nadanat, or you can start in Molag Mar and head northwest towards Mount Kand. Go north around Mount Kand and along the north side of the Foyada.', 'Did you get the excavation report? Do you have it with you?', "Thank you, . This report will be helpful, I'm sure.", 'I need that report, . I cannot work with all these meaningless delays.', "If you have such a keen interest in scholarship, perhaps you'd like to join the Mages Guild.", "What's so important that you would interrupt my studies? If you must have duties for the Mages Guild, I suppose I could think of something.", 'Yes, Warlock , there is something you could do for me. I am looking for a copy of the rare Dwarven book Chronicles of Nchuleft.', 'It is a rare Dwarven tome. None of the Mages Guild branches have a copy, and it is simply *essential* to my research. Would you be willing to find a copy for me?', "Excellent. Here's 250 septims to cover your expenses. Time is of the essence.", "I guess I'll have to get Bribanne Erien to do it.", "Well, don't just stand there. Have you found a copy of Chronicles of Nchuleft or not?", 'You actually found a copy? Excellent, now give the book to me.', "I'm impressed, Warlock . I hope you are always this efficient.", 'I thought we had an agreement, . Apparently your word cannot be trusted.', "What's so important that you would interrupt my studies? If you must have duties for the Mages Guild, I suppose I could think of something.", "I have been waiting for *ages* to get a Detect Creatures potion fron Skink-in-Tree's-Shade in Sadrith Mora.", "It's simply taking Skink-in-Tree's-Shade forever to finish it. Go to Wolverine Hall in Sadrith Mora and bring the potion back to me as soon as Skink is finished.", 'Did you get the Detect Creatures potion from Skins?', "Ah, at last, you've brought me a Detect Creatures potion. Will you give the potion to me now?", "Excellent. Why don't I give you a potion more useful to a Warlock in the field?", 'Unlike a proper Warlock , you do not keep your word. I certainly am not going to give you any more duties until you deliver a Detect Creatures potion to me.', "What's so important that you would interrupt my studies? If you must have duties for the Mages Guild, I suppose I could think of something.", 'Sirilonwe in the Mages Guild in Vivec has somehow acquired a copy of Chimarvamidium.', "It is the sixth volume of Marobar Sul's Ancient Tales of the Dwemer. Most of the Ancient Tales are not truly Dwemer in origin, but this one may be an exception. It deals with some sort of golem or centurion. Would you be willing to borrow this book for me?", "Thank you, . Sirilonwe probably keeps the book near her in the Mages Guild in Vivec. Do whatever it takes to get the book and then return it to me. If you're caught stealing, of course, it is a crime against the guild, so be careful. And take these scrolls just in case.", "Don't think of it as breaking your oath to the Guild, . It is just a small favor. For the advancement of the art and science of magic. If you're caught, of course, you will have to accept the consequences.", 'Did you get Chimarvamidium?', 'You have a copy of Chimarvamidium? Will you let me borrow the book?', 'Thank you, . I will return the book to you soon, but in the meantime, I have more duties for you.', 'That is very disappointing, .', "What's so important that you would interrupt my studies? If you must have duties for the Mages Guild, I suppose I could think of something.", "In order to advance to the rank of Wizard, you must have a Wizard's Staff.", "I could sell you a Wizard's Staff, but they are quite expensive at 5,000 septims. However, I also know of a former member of our order, Anirne, who may still have her Wizard's Staff.", "Very well, I will take your gold... I assume it's all there. And give you this Wizard's Staff.", "Yes, it is wise to keep your Wizard's Staff with you at all times.", 'Congratulations, you are now the Wizard.', "Really any Wizard's Staff will do, but it is no crime to take one from a renegade and outlaw like Anirne. Last I heard, she was in the caverns of Sud.", 'It is a cavern on the far west coast of Sheogorad, due west of Dagon Fel. There is an inlet west of Dagon Fel before you reach the real coast. Do not be fooled by this.', "So you have a Wizard's Staff? Yes, that one will do. You are now ready for advancement.", "What's so important that you would interrupt my studies? If you must have duties for the Mages Guild, I suppose I could think of something.", "I have been distracted from my studies by several reports from Maar Gan. Apparently there is some sort of disturbance at Huleen's hut.", "Since Huleen is a member of the Guild, we really ought to do something about the disturbance. I simply haven't had time to do it myself. My research is at an absolutely critical phase. Would you go to Maar Gan and take a look for me?", "Excellent, . Go to Maar Gan. I'm sure someone there can give you further directions. Take care of this for me so I can continue my studies in peace.", "Well, maybe Tarandur can do it. I'll ask next time I see him. You're not the only Wizard we have, you know.", "What did you find at Huleen's hut? Was it worth all these intolerable interruptions?", "So Huleen's apprentice summoned a scamp? Is that all? I can't believe I was distracted from my studies for something so trivial. Speaking of which, I discovered these scrolls during my research. You may find them useful.", "What's so important that you would interrupt my studies? If you must have duties for the Mages Guild, I suppose I could think of something.", 'Yes, , I have finished my study of Chimarvamidium.', "Can you believe this isn't about a Dwemer construct at all? This book was completely useless. In any case, I need you to return the book before Sirilonwe suspects anything. Return the book to wherever you found it.", 'Did you return Chimarvamidium?', 'The book has been returned? Good work, Wizard . Once I know the locations of some Dwemer ruins, I will be asking you to travel to some dangerous places. These amulets will help you return to safety.', 'More interruptions, Wizard ? Do you want more duties? Why are you here?', "I'm so glad you asked, Wizard . At this delicate phase of my research, I will need to study a Dwemer Tube.", "They're easy enough to find. I believe I saw some in Arkngthunch-Sturdumz when I was last there. Would you be willing to travel there and bring back the Dwemer Tube?", "I appreciate your dedication, . Arkngthunch-Sturdumz is northwest of Gnisis, but there's an easier way to get there. Go to Ald Velothi and follow the coast to the west.", "Dwemer Tubes shouldn't be too hard to find. Go to Ald Velothi and travel along the coast to the west. You'll cross a bridge and you'll see Arkngthunch-Sturdumz ahead of you. You can't miss it.", 'Take the Silt Strider to Gnisis and follow the roads north. I will mark Ald Velothi on your map.', "I'm disappointed, . You are obviously not truly dedicated to research. If you're concerned about Imperial Law, there's no need to worry. I will, of course, turn the device over to the Chair of Dwemer Studies... just as soon as I've finished my research.", "Currently, the Chair is empty and the Great Houses can't agree on a replacement. I believe Hasphat Antabolis was nominated... I'd try to get the position myself, but I fear all the meetings and bookkeeping would take time away from my research.", 'Have you found a Dwemer Tube? Many of my studies cannot continue until I have one in my possession.', 'Have you found a Dwemer Tube?', 'Yes, this is what I wanted. Now I can finally study these bthurkz the Dwarves wrote about. I am impressed by your dedication to scholarship. Good work, .', 'It is not a toy, . It is a valuable Dwemer artifact that is simply essential to my research.', 'More interruptions, Wizard ? Do you want more duties? Why are you here?', 'I want you to find some Dwemer plans or blueprints.', 'Senilias already sent the blueprints he found in Nchuleftingth to the Emperor... But the excavation report mentioned Mzuleft, which is southwest of Dagon Fel. You will need to swim or fly across parts of the Sea of Ghosts. Bring back any plans or blueprints you find.', 'Well, have you found and Dwemer plans yet?', 'Did you drop them on the way back? Where are they?', 'If you refuse to hand the blueprints over, I will have no choice but to report this to the rest of the Mages Guild and the Imperial Authorities.', 'This is interesting... The excavation report mentions another Dwemer ruin, Mzuleft. Would you go there and look for some blueprints?', 'Did you find any plans or blueprints in Mzuleft?', 'Well, have you found and Dwemer plans yet?', 'Yes, this is exactly what I was looking for. Excellent work, Wizard .', 'More interruptions, Master Wizard ? Do you want more duties? Why are you here?', 'I have heard that miners in the Gnisis Eggmine broke into the ruins of Bethamez.', 'Officially, the Gnisis eggmine was closed because of blight, but I heard that miners broke into the lost Dwemer ruin of Bethamez. I have also heard that they found Dwemer plans similar to the blueprints you brought me before. Go to the Gnisis eggmine and bring back any plans or blueprints you find.', 'I believe there are more blueprints in Bethamez.', 'Have you found any more Dwemer plans or blueprints?', "Well, where are they? Didn't you bring the plans with you?", 'I understand the temptation of scholarship, but this is not the time to joke around.', 'Did you find any plans or blueprints in Bethamez?', 'Have you found any more Dwemer plans or blueprints?', "This is really remarkable, . These plans are very similar. Perhaps with both of them in my possession, I can discover their secrets. It's a shame Arch-Mage Trebonius doesn't share your dedication to scholarship.", 'Someday your work in Dwemer archeology may surpass even myself or Hasphat Antabolis.', 'Both of these plans seem to be for some kind of metal insect. I do not know what to make of them yet. I will keep you fully informed of any discoveries, Master Wizard .', 'This book is puzzling to me. You might want to ask Hasphat Antabolis in Balmora.', 'Hm. I do not know what to tell you about that book. I can make sense of Dwemer plans, but I cannot read their language. You might want to ask Hasphat Antabolis in Balmora.', "I cannot make sense of this. Even when I try using this Hanging Gardens you've found as a translation key, the words simply do not make any sense. I am certain the author did not know any magic himself. Yes, these are probably just the ramblings of some Dwarven lunatic.", 'Now this is an interesting book, . It appears to be written in btoh Dwemer and Aldmeris. If you could find a scholar of the Dwemer who knew Aldmeris, you might be able to translate portions of the Dwemer text. This book is priceless in the right hands.', 'More interruptions, Master Wizard? Do you want more duties? Why are you here?', "It's a shame the Mages Guild isn't led by someone with your devotion to Scholarship. Perhaps if you speak with Trebonius, you can make him listen to reason.", 'I wish the Guild were led by someone with your respect for scholarship, Master Wizard. Perhaps you could speak with him and make him see reason.']

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ["I am Elam Andas, chief of Vivec's Order of the Watch. Do you have questions about my trade? Or are you here looking for work?", 'The Order of the Watch provides guards for temples and shrines. Here in Vivec, which is a Temple city, we are the guards who enforce the law and preserve order.', 'Is this about the work I mentioned? Or did you have other questions?', "We've had seven killings in Vivec recently. All the victims had their throats slit. Most did not appear to have struggled. Five victims were outlanders. Two were Ordinators. The two Ordinators were armed and on duty. Their weapons were still in their belts. Nothing was removed from the victim's bodies. I cannot hire you. Only Ordinators may serve the Watch. But if you can find this killer, and execute him, I personally promise you a very handsome reward. I require no commitment from you. Indeed I cannot officially accept one. But if you are interested, I can tell you what we know about the seven victims and the reports of witnesses.", "None of the five outlander victims had been on Vvardenfell longer than a week. Two were found in Foreign Quarters corridors, one on Foreign Quarter Canalside, one in a Hlaalu Compound corridor, and one in the water near the Arena. All were armed. Only one, a mage, seems to have put up a fight. All had their throats slit with a dagger. Until the two Ordinators were killed, we thought it might be an anti-Imperial fanatic. And it still might be. The two Ordinators were found dead near the victim at Hlaalu Compound, and we think they coincidentally interrupted the killer at work. Both had their throats slit with a dagger. That neither Ordinator had drawn a weapon is extremely unsettling. It suggests either extraordinary stealth, or a very powerful sorcerer. That's all we know about the victims. And there's not much information from witnesses, either.", "There are no witnesses to any of the killings. But in Hlaalu compound, at about the same time of one of the killings, an outlander reported being threatened by Dunmer woman armed with a dagger. It was dark, and the outlander transported magically to safety, so he couldn't give us a very clear description. But he was sure the Dunmer woman with a dagger was dressed an a skirt and netch leather armor.", "Yes. That's the only description we have. A Dunmer woman with a dagger, in a skirt and netch leather armor.", 'As I said, I cannot officially hire you for this task. But if you find and execute this killer, when you return to report your success to me, I promise you a handsome reward.', 'Is this about the work I mentioned? Or did you have other questions?', "According to your report, the Dunmer woman you killed matches the description given us. We'll dispatch Ordinators to follow up, But I believe you have identified and executed the killer. On behalf on the city, and of the Office of the Watch, thank you. And now for the reward I promised. I'll give you a choice. You may either have an Indoril helm and cuirass, or a Belt of the Armor of God. The helm and cuirass are heavy armor, and useful only to a strong fighter. These items belonged to one of the Ordinators who were killed, and it is fitting that they should reward the one who avenged his murder. However, we ask that you don't wear this armor in Vivec City, for you may be mistaken for an Ordinator and guard. Alternatively, the Belt of the Armor of God provides magical armor and improves resistence against hostile spells, and should be useful for any adventurer. Which would you like?", 'Very good. Please accept the helm and cuirass, with our thanks. And accept, on the behalf of Vivec City, our thanks for ridding us of this dangerous killer.', 'Very good. Please accept the belt, with our thanks. And accept, on the behalf of Vivec City, our thanks for ridding us of this dangerous killer.', "I am grateful for the work you did for us. But I'm afraid I have no more work for you. Thank you anyway."]

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ['What are you doing here? What can I do for you?', 'If you want to set us free, look for the key to our bracers somewhere here in the egg mine or in Tel Branora.', 'Yes, we are rebelling. If Therana sent you, go ahead and kill us.', 'Therana is mad. She demands more and more kwama eggs, and when the mine is empty, she still demands more. I delivered the eggs last time, and found she was not even eating them. She was decorating her home with rotting kwama eggs. It was then I decided I could not go on.', 'I am surprised you are willing to listen... Will you help us? I was a sorcerer in Black Marsh, but I cannot cast spells with these slave bracers on. Will you find the key to our slave bracers and free us? There may be a key here, but we have not yet found it. I am sure there is a key in Tel Branora.', 'You will free us? I am not sure I believe you... Very well. Try and find a key to my slave bracers in Tel Branora or here in the egg mine. Once I am free, I will let the others go free and lead them to safety.', 'Have you found the key? Will you let me go free?', 'I would rather die free than be a slave again.', 'I would rather die free than be a slave again.', 'I would rather die free than be a slave again.', 'Do you have the key to these bracers? Will you let me go free?', 'Have you found the key? Will you let me go free?', 'Have you found the key?', 'Yes, I am free now. I will free the others and lead them back to Black Marsh.', 'Yes, I will free the other slaves. I will guide them back to Black Marsh when it is safe.', 'Yes, I will free the others. Soon we will return to Black Marsh.', 'If you set me free, I will free any slaves that remain here and lead them to safety.']

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ["Okay, I confess. I stole them under contract with the Thieves Guild. They are in the chest on my windowsill. Here is the key. Odral Helvi has abused his power and made many enemies. Flatter him a bit, make up some story about where you found the contracts, and I'll put in a good word for you with my Guild and with House Hlaalu.", "I've given you the key. Take the documents back to Odral, but don't tell him that it was me, all right? Just make up some story.", 'Thanks, .']

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ['Red Mountain spreads ash and blight! Sinners gather at the House! The time of the Incarnate is at hand!', 'You disbelieve? I know my destiny. And you will have a hard time proving otherwise. I have seen the message in the dream. Have you not also experienced the waking dream?', 'You cannot harm me, pawn of the Temple! Leave before I prove the truth of my prophecies on your flesh!', 'Who then, if not myself? The dreams are unyielding! Every day, every night! I must be the one... I must... No, your words are not convincing enough.', 'Who then, if not myself? There must be a meaning to these dreams. Perhaps you are right... Your words have guided me. I will seek penance for my sins. Forgive me and thank you.', 'I will no longer claim to be the Incarnate.', 'I have seen the error of my ways, . Your wisdom has guided me through the most disturbing time.']

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ['You are suggesting we have done this thing? That is fine, %PCRace, for it is true. Kashtes and I have taken the hides, and in our possession they will remain. Prepare to meet your gods, for no one may take what is now ours.']

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ["Here's a recent edition of the Brown Book of Great House Telvanni. It lists the current Telvanni councilors and their residences. Let me mark the locations of the councilor's towers on your map -- Tel Aruhn, Tel Vos, Tel Mora, Tel Branora. And Tel Naga is right in the center of Sadrith Mora."]

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ['What brings you to the Temple, Diviner ? Have you been lax in your duties?', 'A holy woman here in Vivec is spreading the Divine Disease to others. Someone must convince Tanusea Veloth to leave Vivec City.', "Tanusea Veloth is a holy Pilgrim and well loved by the people. Do not kill her unless there is no other way. Try and convince her to go to the Corprusarium before she spreads the Divine Disease to others. She is very devout and would be most easily impressed by some show of your devotion to the Temple's teachings.", 'Did you convince Tanusea Veloth to leave Vivec City?', 'You may find her in the Arena Canton.', 'Did you convince Tanusea Veloth to leave Vivec City?', "She's over at the Arena. She has Corprus. Don't go near her.", 'I am glad you were able to convince Tanusea Veloth to leave. She will be cared for in the Corprusarium and will no longer spread tje disease. Since you may have been exposed to a blight disease, please take these potions. Are you ready for further duties?', 'What brings you to the Temple, Diviner ? Have you been lax in your duties?', 'To prove that you have patience and wisdom you must make the Pilgrimage to the Sanctus Shrine.', 'To make the Pilgrimage, I must swear you to silence. If you speak with anyone before reaching the shrine, you will have broken your vow. Before you are sworn to silence, you may wish to purchase some potions of levitation or water walking. There is no easy way to get to the Sanctus Shrine in Dagon Fel and the waters can be dangerous. Tell me when you are ready to take the vow of Silence.', 'I swear you to silence. You may not speak again until you reach the Sanctus Shrine in Dagon Fel. The shrine is on an island west of Sheogorad. Look for a shack with a triolith beside it. I will mark it on your map.', 'You may wait as long as you wish.', 'Have you completed the pilgrimage to the Sanctus Shrine?', 'Obviously you have failed your pilgrimage to the Sanctus Shrine.', 'You broke your oath of silence, Diviner . This is disappointing. Perhaps you are not suited for the Temple.', 'You have already attempted your Pilgrimage to the Sanctus Shrine.', 'Have you completed the pilgrimage to the Sanctus Shrine?', 'You made the pilgrimage to the Sanctus Shrine, and you have proven your piety. I celebrate your devotion. Perhaps you would enjoy these books.', 'You have already made your Pilgrimage to the Sanctus Shrine.', 'What brings you to the Temple, Diviner ? Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ["That lowly Hlaalu trader? He's ridiculous.", "He thinks I might be interested in him? Ha! That's a ridiculous notion. The very thought...insane. I mean, has he seen himself in a mirror lately? I'm sure he's a decent enough sort, but that's ridiculous. He might be more suited for my cousin Glathel. She's low-born, plain, and desperate for a husband. But me? You can tell Gadayn that you've spoken to Eraldil, and she's not interested!", "She's a decent, if rather common sort. I mean, I don't have much to do with her. She's rather plain, not too bright. But she's not a bad person, for what she is. You can find her at the Elven Nations Cornerclub. She's a serving girl.", "He wishes to apologize? How very noble. But, at least he sent a gift along, which is certainly appropriate. Well, I'm sure I'll have use for it sometime, although it's probably not even of good quality.", "That husband of mine? He's cheap, pathetic, stupid, lazy, messy, uncaring, clinging, and rather smelly. But I love him!", "Have you heard? Seven victims? Here in Vivec? All with their throats slit? When it was just a few outlanders killed, the Ordinators weren't making much fuss. But now that they've had two of their own people with slit throats, they seem very concerned at the Hall of Justice. I've heard that the Office of the Watch is quietly looking around for some special help. Anything that can kill TWO Ordinators before they can draw their weapons sounds like it will NEED special help."]

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ["Welcome to Gnisis, . I'm Ertius Fulbenus. Can I help you find someone in particular? Or are you just looking for a little advice from a local?", "Mehra Drora is Gnisis Temple Priestess. Hetman Abelmawia is Village Hetman. General Darius lead the Deathshead Legion garrison at Fort Darius; Optio Bologra, an Orc, is Deathshead Legion's Camp Prefect. Fenas Madach runs the Madach Tradehouse. A renegade Telvanni wizard, Baladas Demnevanni, lives in Arvs Drelen, the Old Veloth tower.", "Optio Bologra is the Camp Prefect of the Deathshead Legion garrison at Fort Darius. He's a tough and violent orc, not clever or polished, but nonetheless an effective and respected officer.", "The Empire built a fort near Gnisis village with the help of House Redoran. They named this fort after the garrison's commandant, General Darius.", "He's here, check his office on the lower level.", "He keeps to himself, has his food and supplies delivered to the door. He's been a good neighbor, quiet, no trouble.", "Mehra Drora is our local priestess over at the Gnisis Temple. She heals and trains the Temple faithful... for a fee. She's Indoril -- a Great House traditionally linked to the New Temple cult -- but not a snob or prig, like most Indorils."]

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ['Welcome, Incarnate. I am Erur-Dan. I was not the one. But I wait and hope. Ask, and I shall tell you my story.', 'I saw Morrowind fall to the Empire. I lived through the humiliation of the surrender, swore hatred and vengeance against Imperial and Tribunal alike for their betrayals. In later years, I despaired, and turned to Red Mountain, where I grew old and died fighting the blight and Red Mountain monsters. Take my weapons and armor. I have no further use for them.', 'I have failed. I was not the one.', 'A darkness is on the land, and only you can bring the light.', 'I am Erur-Dan. I was called to the prophecies, but I was not the one.', 'You are the Prophesied One. You must save the Dunmer people.', 'An ancestor has no trade, but to guard and counsel the living kin.', 'You are the Nerevarine. You are the Incarnate. You are the one. You must not fail.', 'The Devil is dead, and the Blight is gone. You are the Nerevarine. You are the Incarnate. You are the one.']

I am impressed, Grandmaster. Pleace accept the payment for this Writ.', 'The Writ on Mistress Therana has been executed.']

Dialogues: ["I'm not interested, fetcher.", 'Am I talking to you, fetcher? No. I am talking to the filthy lizard. So push off.', "Go ahead. Keep talking. And I'm gonna pop your head off, and feed it to the filthy lizard.", "Hey, look. It's none of my business. Folks want to talk to a filthy lizard, it's their problem, not mine. Got out of here. And good riddance.", "Fine, he wants a filthy lizard in here, I don't care. We'll leave him alone.", 'Oh, go away, will you.', 'What, are you some kind of filthy lizard lover? You wanta give your little friend a big kiss?', 'Blah, blah, blah. He can stay here forever, for all I care. Not my problem.', "They're stupid, they stink, whattya expect? Nobody likes 'em. But there're not worth worrying about."]

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ['You are in the Balmora Guild of Fighters now. I am the Guild Steward.', ". The citizens give us duties and gold, and I pass some of them on to you. When you're ready for advancement, just come ask me and I'll tell you if you're ready or not.", "You want to join the Fighters Guild? I'm the steward here in Balmora.", "They're southwest of the town of Caldera, I believe. Check around when you're in Caldera. They'll give you better directions.", "You'll find basic supplies: arrows, bolts, healing potions. If you need more healing than that, head to the temple. We're able to resupply the chest once in a while, but don't count on it.", 'I have a very simple contract to end an infestation of cave rats. You might be able to handle it.', "You've been expelled from the Fighters Guild. Until you make amends, I cannot discuss contracts with you.", "You've been expelled from the Fighters Guild. Until you make amends, I cannot discuss contracts with you.", "You've been expelled from the Fighters Guild. Until you make amends, I cannot discuss contracts with you.", "You've been expelled from the Fighters Guild. Until you make amends, I cannot discuss contracts with you.", ". You'll have to make amends.", "You've been expelled from the Fighters Guild. Until you make amends, I cannot discuss contracts with you.", "You've been expelled from the Fighters Guild. Until you make amends, I cannot discuss contracts with you.", ". You'll have to make amends.", "You've been expelled from the Fighters Guild. Until you make amends, I cannot discuss contracts with you.", "He's Thieves Guild, a Wood Elf. The Telvanni prefer to hire Nords and Wood Elves when they can't get natives. I know nothing about him. But this is not a Thieves Guild job, so he has no protection.", "She's been expelled from the Fighters Guild. She stole from her Guild Steward. She's stupid, but she can fight. She joined the Thieves Guild when we kicked her out, but she's nobody important. This Caldera Mine trouble is not a Thieves Guild job.", "She's Thieves Guild, a local Dark Elf. She's known on Azura's Coast. She could be trouble. But like I told you: this Caldera Mine trouble is not a Thieves Guild job.", "Helaviane Desele owes one of our clients 200 septims. Deliver Desele's debt money to me.", 'We have a contract from the Caldera Mining Company to kill four Telvanni agents responsible for trouble at the Caldera Mine.', "She's Thieves Guild, a local Dark Elf, no one important. And this Caldera Mine trouble has nothing to do with the Thieves Guild.", "The Caldera Mining Company says they've learned a group of Telvanni agents are spying on the Caldera Mine works. There have been a number of ebony thefts, missing guards, escaped slaves, and these Telvanni agents are responsible.", "I told you. This Caldera Mine trouble is not a Thieves Guild job. Yes. They are Thieves Guild. And if you belong to the Thieves Guild, and you murder a Thieves Guild member, you get expelled. But it's only murder if the crime is reported. And you're not going to report it, are you? And, after all, I'm your Fighters Guild Steward, and I'm giving you a job to do. Don't make me wonder about where your loyalties lie.", "You got both of them? Good. Here's your payment. 100 septims. And we've got some extra potions from a recent raid. Take these. They'll come in handy. Just tell me when you're ready for more orders.", "Yes. Egg poachers. May sound silly, but those kwama eggs are among the few things worth exporting from this nasty little province. Dram Bero, the owner of Shulk Egg Mine, wants to make an example of these thieves to keep other miners from getting funny ideas. The egg poachers, Sevilo Othan and Daynila Valas, are former egg miners, and long-time local troublemakers. You can handle that, can't you? Report back when the poachers are dead.", 'Have you taken care of those egg poachers yet?', "The mine is a short distance southwest of Balmora, in the bluffs west of the Odai River. The old suspension bridge across the Odai is just southeast of the mine entrance. Follow the river south of Balmora until you see the bridge overhead. You're not afraid of a little swim, are you?", "I already told you how to get there. And I don't like repeating myself.", 'The code book our client wants is in the hands of Sottilde at the South Wall in Balmora. Find that code book and bring it back to me.', 'No loss.', "She's not a problem any more.", 'Not very tough, as it turned out. Eh?', 'I need someone to return a code book that belongs to our client.', "She wasn't important.", "She's Thieves Guild. I take full responsibility. And listen. I'm Guild Steward. When I say jump, you ask, 'How high?' Keep that in mind, and we won't have any problems.", 'You took care of that.', "I told you, right? You slow or something? It wasn't a Thieves Guild job. And that's all water under the bridge, anyway.", "You got all four? Good. That'll make some people at Caldera Mining Company very happy. And here's 400 septims. The Caldera Mining Company pays well. And when your ready for more orders, let me know.", "Four Telvanni agents are responsible for thefts and disappearances at the Caldera ebony mines. Their names are Alynu Aralen, Sathasa Nerothren, Fothyna Herothran, and Alveleg. They're hiding in a cave in the hills north of Caldera Mine. When the four agents are dead, report back to me. Take care, it's very likely that one of them is on lookout posted outside the mines. The quickest way to Caldera is probably to have the guild guide at the Mages Guild transport you, but it is your choice.", 'When the four Telvanni agents are dead, report back to me.', "So you think you can bribe me to betray Sjoring Hard-Heart? Well, you might be right. If you give me the Bitter Cup, I'll pledge my support to the Thieves Guild.", "So be it. I take this Bitter Cup and pledge to support you against Sjoring Hard-Heart. I never liked the way the Camonna Tong was using an Imperial Guild to destroy another Imperial Guild. Tell the Master Thief to contact me when he's ready.", 'Yes, you gave me the Bitter Cup. I have not forgotten.', "Since you brought me the Bitter Cup, I'm not working against the Thieves Guild anymore. You have my word.", 'I know that some gifts of Clavicus Vile can be hard to part with. If you change your mind, you know where to find me.', "Go to Drarayne Thelas' house. It's here in Balmora, along the river on the east side. Ask her where the rats are coming from. Kill the rats and get your payment from Drarayne Thelas. Report back to me once you've taken care of this.", '? Not bad...for you. You ready for more orders?', "There's nothing more to say about that.", "Since you brought me the Bitter Cup, I'm not working against the Thieves Guild anymore. You have my word.", "Yes. Egg poachers. May sound silly, but those kwama eggs are among the few things worth exporting from this nasty little province. Dram Bero, the owner of Shulk Egg Mine, wants to make an example of these thieves to keep other miners from getting funny ideas. The egg poachers, Sevilo Othan and Daynila Valas, are former egg miners, and long-time local troublemakers. You can handle that, can't you? Report back when the poachers are dead.", "A local egg mine has problems with egg poachers. And you're going to solve those problems.", ". I've learned something unfortunate happened to Drarayne Thelas. Are you ready for more orders?", ". It's unhealthy.", "Helaviane Desele owes one of our clients 200 septims. Deliver Desele's debt money to me.", '. The guild needs more like you—obedient and efficient. If you want more orders, just ask.', 'You already have the code book? You have good instincts. Well, just hand it over and these 50 septims are yours.', ". Hand it over and I'll get your payment.", 'The code book our client wants is in the hands of Sottilde at the South Wall in Balmora. Find that code book and bring it back to me.', "I'll pass any debt collection contracts your way.", 'I have a bounty contract for the Orc Dura gra-Bol.', "You killed Helviane Desele? Well, that's the way it is sometimes. Some people won't pay their debts.", ". Here's your share.", 'Go get it then.', 'Do you have the 200 septims Desele owes our client?', "Helviane Desele runs a cornerclub in Suran. She owes Manos Othreleth, one of our clients, 200 septims. Bring this money to me and I'll let you keep half of it.", "I don't have any more bounty contracts right now.", 'Alof the Easterner has seen Orc outlaws near his farm. I have a contract from Duke Dren himself to investigate the Orcs at a Daedric ruin.', "I don't have orders for anyone under the rank of Protector. Find out what you need for advancement. The Guild Stewards at Vivec City, Sadrith Mora, or Ald'ruhn might have some work for you in the meantime.", 'You already killed Dura gra-Bol? Well, then, these 250 septims are yours.', "I heard that Dura gra-Bol is dead. Here's your 250 septims.", 'This Orc is an outlaw, living openly in a house here in Balmora. I have a contract here that says 250 septims are yours if you bring her to justice.', 'A distinguished client has placed a contract on the Verethi Gang.', "Alof says the Orcs are gone. Here's 500 septims for the Duke's contract.", "If you already killed those Orcs, why did I get this contract? Well, rules are rules. Here's the 500 septims, your share of what the Duke paid.", "Duke Vedam Dren himself gave us a contract to take care of the problem. Go to Alof's Farm northeast of Pelagiad and just north of the Arvel Plantation. Alof can tell you where the Orcs are and what needs to be done.", "? Well, the contract still needs to be filled. Apparently, our only source of information is dead, so you'll just have to search the area until you figure out which orcs to get rid of. Check for any ruins nearby; it'd be a good place for them to hide out.", 'Everyone is grateful to you for clearing the Tomb of the Hunger.', 'What can I do for you, Guildmaster?', ". Try asking the Guild Stewards at Vivec City, Sadrith Mora, or Ald'ruhn.", "I am sure the Sarano family is grateful. In the meantime, here's some more tangible gratitude: 1000 septims.", 'You already killed the Hunger? Then take the 1000 septims for this contract.', 'A Hunger has violated the Sarano Tomb. Go to this tomb, which is over the hills southeast of Fort Moonmoth between the Ashlands and Lake Amaya, and kill the Hunger.', "The Verethi Gang won't trouble anyone anymore.", 'There is a dangerous creature loose in the Sarano Ancestral Tomb.', ". Here's the 1000 septims from the contract.", 'If you already killed Dovres Verethi, then I guess I ought to go ahead and pay you the 1000 septims.', 'Our client wants the leader of the Verethi Gang, Dovres Verethi, killed. The Verethi Gang are smugglers based in Mannammu just southeast of Pelagiad. Kill Dovres Verethi and report back to me for 1000 septims.']

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ["Yes, I have such a red shirt with a black vest. But why should I give this to you for free? The Imperial cult is too poor to pay for my work? I don't think so.", 'Indeed? I do make a fine garment, if I do say so myself, and the red shirt with the black vest is one of my favorite traditional designs. And, I admit, I am weak when it comes to such generous praise. Here. Please accept the shirt and vest for the Imperial cult, with my compliments. And also, for yourself, take another shirt, with these matching trousers.', 'I hope you are pleased with my donations.']

Title: Elder Scrolls Morrowind
Dialogues: ['My name is Falura Llervu, sera. If you wish to purchase me, you must speak to Savile Imayn.', 'My name is Falura Llervu. Savile Imayn has told me that you plan for me to marry an Ashlander lord. Savile Imayn has taught me what to say and do, and I would be very happy to do this thing. All that remains is for you to purchase me.', 'Yes, sera. Falura Llervu of Velothis Haven, daughter of Andrano Llervu, lord of Tel Llervu, pleased to make your acquaintance. See? Savile Imayn has taught me well. I shall BE a high-born Telvanni lady, and no one will know the difference. Just like a lady. I admit, I am a little anxious about marrying an Ashlander, even an Ashlander chief, but anything is better than being a slave, and I am very tough and smart, and determined to make the best of my chances. But Savile Imayn said you wanted to give me something. Some presents....', 'I am yours. Now I cannot wait to meet my bridegroom.', "I'm sure she said you had some presents for me. She said you would give them to me before we leave for Zainab camp to meet my bridegroom.", 'Oh, sera! These clothes! They are divine! Such a perfume! Only the very rich can afford this! I shall do everything I can to please you and my new master... that is, my gracious lord and husband-to-be. Come! I am so excited, I cannot wait! Let us travel together to Zainab camp and meet this Zainab lord.', 'Are we ready to travel together to Zainab camp? Do not worry if we must cross water, for I am an excellent swimmer. But take care to protect me from wild beasts and bandits, for I have not learned any of the arts of war. I do know a few spells, but they the spells of a household slave, and will probably be of little use if we are in danger. So. Shall we go now?', 'Very well, then. I will wait here for now. When you are ready, come to me, and I will travel together with you to Zainab camp to meet my new bridegroom.', "But, first, didn't you have some presents for me?", "Very well, . Now you and I will travel together. When we have arrived in the ashkhan's yurt at Zainab camp, we will speak further about my new bridegroom.", 'Yes, yes, sera. Yes, we are here safely. And this fine man, he is to be my bridegroom?', "He is very distinguished-looking, isn't he? A bit severe, perhaps, but the lines on his face, there, show that he likes to smile. Oh, sera. I think I will be very happy.", 'You are the Nerevarine? But... you are an outlander. How can that be? Such wonders in the world. Before, I was a slave; now I am a companion of the Nerevarine and the bride of a Zainab chief.', "It was quite a journey, wasn't it?", 'Yes, thank you, sera. He is a very fine man, and I am very happy.', 'I am Falura Llervu, bride of the Ashkhan Kaushad of the Zainab Ashlanders.', 'Thank you, sera. I am very pleased with Ashkhan Kaushad. He is good-looking, clever, and rich, although a bit full of himself, like all men. Thank you for being my matchmaker and benefactor, and I hope you will return to visit when I have brought many fine sons and daughters to Ashkhan Kaushad.', 'Yes, Nerevarine. I am very happy. And I think Kaushad is happy with his bride. I hope soon to bear Kaushad many fine sons and daughters, and I think our first-born should bear your name, if the spirits are willing.']
